summary: Kairos privately confirms the five main League players and prepares the organization for public launch. The episode uses historical nicknames that are replaced by current canon.
keyEvents: Noah Bennett is selected for Top.
Ethan Walker is selected for Jungle.
Mason Brooks is selected for Mid.
Liam O'Connor is selected for ADC.
Daniel Reyes is selected for Support and captain.
consequences: The main League roster is complete.
Moss becomes captain of the main roster.
